prompt: She starts moving at once: one step forward towards the camera, then another, with the camera easing slowly back in front of her. On the second step she turns her head left to glance at the old computer monitor and teacups under the plastic sheet, gives a tiny, tired breath out through her nose, and looks forward again, still walking. A drop of rain runs off the edge of her hood. The people in the background shift their weight and browse at their own stalls without coming closer. Her expression stays weary and unimpressed; she says nothing. Sound: light rain pattering on the plastic sheeting and gazebo roofs, squelch of mud underfoot, low far-off crowd murmur. Grey natural light, documentary realism.
